label: ERW forecast
what: the forecast two to seven days ahead walked from 1 July 2016, on the authorities' demand of EIA's six-month files before July 2018 (eia930_all_history) and the hourly table after: each horizon h (days between the last whole day read and the day forecast) with the same two regressions refit at that horizon, its method chosen now as ahead.py chooses it (the lower mean absolute error of the two over the last two years), scored by the calendar year of the target day on the hours every candidate holds, against the same hour a week ago; beats: the method's mean absolute error below the week-ago hour's that year. ahead.json and ahead_more.json are unchanged
